mentions.note: Belgrave sprinter (first name only printed; evidently Ernie Obeng); 10.57 for 100m

photos.c: A highlight of this years BAL matches has been the sprints and relays with Todd Bennett turning out for Southampton and Ernest for Belgrave. In the final Match our sprint relay squad just held off a classy Southampton squad, broke the Div 3 record & sliced a huge 1.2 secs off the Club record. Todd hands to Roger Black and Ernie to Phil Goedluck.
